items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: There was one fella, Roy, they call him, used to live uptown, he used to play with Chris Kelly's band. And he was one fella that I saw do that. And I kept that up.

ctx.x: I don't see many fellas beat like that. There was one fella, Roy, they call him, used to live uptown, he used to play with Chris Kelly's band. And he was one fella that I saw do that. And I kept that up. But I don't, I don't see fellas beat like that. I can't beat with my foot on the ground. I can, you know what I mean? But I don't give quick action like, I just beat with my toes.
I'm just about out of this reel here if you feel like going another half hour. I can go as long as you want to go. Alright, unless you're worn out. We don't want to make you get tired. Tired?
